details: Developed and maintained Java and Spring Boot backend services supporting enterprise business workflows.
Implemented REST APIs for application features, including request validation, exception handling, and database integration.
Worked with Spring Data JPA and Hibernate for database operations, and integrated Redis caching to reduce repetitive query load on relational data.
Deployed containerized backend services to Kubernetes clusters, configuring NGINX Ingress routing rules, endpoints, and health check probes.
Investigated application defects and resolved backend issues through debugging, log analysis, and code fixes.
Developed unit tests using JUnit and Mockito to validate business logic, and participated in Agile development, code reviews, and releases.
Developed backend RESTful services using Java and Spring Boot to support wealth management business workflows.
Implemented and integrated REST APIs with internal backend modules and external financial service gateways.
Wrote and maintained database queries and entity mappings using Spring Data JPA and Hibernate for data processing.
Participated in peer code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile delivery ceremonies to maintain code quality standards.
Developed backend REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA for order processing and tracking workflows.
Implemented business logic, request validation, and exception handling to ensure robust API behavior.
Maintained relational database interactions and resolved backend defects identified during QA testing cycles.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in daily standups and sprint retrospectives to deliver scheduled features.
Developed core Java application modules and scheduled batch processing jobs for public assistance case management systems.
Authored automated unit tests using JUnit and Mockito to validate business logic and improve test coverage.
Investigated defect tickets, performed debugging and root cause analysis, and deployed code fixes within SLA timelines.
Collaborated with senior developers on requirements analysis and technical documentation.
